title: OCR 失败模式：低置信度与乱码兜底
code:
ocr_results = [
    {"text": "正常发票内容", "conf": 0.98},
    {"text": "##########", "conf": 0.21},
    {"text": "金额: 123.45", "conf": 0.91},
    {"text": "✱✱✱✱✱", "conf": 0.34},
]
GARBLED = set("✱#@*%&")
def needs_review(r):
    if r["conf"] < 0.5:
        return True
    if any(ch in GARBLED for ch in r["text"]):
        return True
    return False
review = [r["text"] for r in ocr_results if needs_review(r)]
print("需人工复核:", review)
print("通过:", [r["text"] for r in ocr_results if not needs_review(r)])
